Explore Selemene engines, choose a reflection focus, prepare required inputs, and receive brief or detailed integrated readings in your current ChatGPT conversation. ChatGPT composes the integrated synthesis; the service does not invoke another narration model. Gene Keys canonical activation coordinates and source-qualified short public labels are available; full author meanings and biological correspondences remain unavailable.

No personal Selemene account, login, or API key is needed. Free access is subject to service quotas and availability. Submitted inputs and results can be stored under a shared service/admin account and may update its profile, history, usage, XP or automatically derived access phase; this creates no personal linked account or private history. The plugin discloses this before execution and preserves missing inputs and partial results. Detailed readings are composed in ChatGPT; available host-native file tools can provide requested exports. Hosted witness/report generation and independent certification are not invoked. Medical diagnosis, guaranteed predictions, account administration, media analysis, and paid generation are outside this plugin.
